programme.title: Zulu Dawn
programme.desc: In 1879 South Africa, British Cape Colony administrators seek to crush the Zulus, viewing them as an obstacle to their colonial ambitions. To provoke war, they issue King Cetshwayo an impossible ultimatum, confident their rifles and artillery will ensure an easy victory. But as Lord Chelmsford’s forces chase an unseen foe, they discover near Isandlwana how gravely they’ve underestimated the Zulu nation’s skill and strength.

programme.title: The Perfect Cheerleader
programme.desc: When Cassie Talbot gets into the college of her dreams and makes the cheerleading squad, she feels her whole world is changing, for the better! She has new friends, cheerleading is exciting, things are good... But when a handsome man comes into her life, she slowly uncovers a dark secret. And when a fellow cheerleader disappears, and is found dead under suspicious circumstances, it unlocks a deadly conspiracy, putting her life in grave danger

programme.title: Cheer for your Life

programme.title: Inside Out
programme.desc: Three decades after WWII ended, a group of ex-GIs and German soldiers are aiming to recover Nazi treasure stashed away in the Soviet-controlled part of East Germany. Only a Nazi war criminal, who is behind bars, knows the precise spot where it's hidden.

programme.title: Charade
programme.desc: Romance and intrigue ensue in Paris as a woman is pursued by several men who want to get their hands on a fortune her murdered husband had stolen. She soon loses trust in those who claim they want to help her.

programme.title: The Krays: Dead Man Walking
programme.desc: Based on real events, this intense story follows London's infamous brothers, Reggie and Ronnie Kray, as they spring Frank 'The Mad Axeman' Mitchell from Dartmoor Prison in December 1966.

programme.title: Death Race 2000
programme.desc: In a dystopian future, a cross country automobile race requires contestants to run down innocent pedestrians to gain points that are tallied based on each kill's brutality.

programme.title: #No Joke
programme.desc: A musician's journey to create a song with some of the biggest stars in the industry. Along the way, he faces up to his painful past, while giving viewers a deep personal insight into the issue of bullying.

programme.title: Spy Dog
programme.desc: Toby appears to be an ordinary dog living the simple put life, but unbeknownst to his family, he moonlights as secret government operative, Agent Toby Barks. AKA Agent Toby Barks

programme.title: Designed with Love
programme.desc: Trying to find a market for her clothing line, designer Skye goes mobile with a 'fashion truck' – but can’t drive the truck and run the business all alone. programme.title: For the Love of Chocolate
programme.desc: As Aria gets ready for the yearly Masters of Chocolate Festival, things take a turn when her partner quits just before the big event. But soon, a charming single dad comes to her rescue, helping her discover the secret to winning.

programme.title: A Star is Born (1937)

programme.title: Cold Zone
programme.desc: A storm is coming. No one could predict it. No one can measure it.Now one family must survive it. You can't come in from the cold.

programme.title: For the Love of Spock
programme.desc: For the Love of Spock is a heartfelt documentary celebrating the life and legacy of Leonard Nimoy and his iconic portrayal of Spock. Featuring interviews with Zoe Saldaña, Chris Pine, Karl Urban and many more, the film explores how one character became a cultural phenomenon. Directed by Adam Nimoy, Leonard’s son, this intimate tribute blends behind-the-scenes stories, personal memories and fan devotion. A must-watch for Star Trek fans and anyone fascinated by the impact of a true pop culture icon.
